attributes.name: Mistress Anemora
attributes.powers:
Mistress Anemora is immune to the Mental trait. All damage dealt by Mistress Anemora is Poison damage.

Before you act, discard a spell, then each character at the location is dealt 1d4+1 Poison damage.
